text:
For seventeen months I have screamed,

calling you back to the fold.

I threw myself at the executioner's feet.

You are my son, turned specter.

Confusion seizes the world

and I lack the strength to distinguish

between a beast and a human being,

or on what day the word kill! is spelled out.

Nothing remains but dusty flowers,

a tinkling censer and footprints

that lead nowhere. Stone night,

whose bright and gigantic star

stares into my eyes,

promising me death. Ah, soon!

translation.title: For Seventeen Months I Have Screamed
translation.editorial_note: The translation keeps the motherly desperation, failed distinctions, and stone-night death promise.
